title: आधुनिक नेपाली कथा : मोड र प्रवृत्ति Aadhunik Nepali Katha : Mod ra Prabritti
nepali: (आधुनिक नेपाली कथा लेखनको प्रारम्भ भएको समयदेखि वर्तमान समयसम्म विभिन्न मोड र प्रवृत्तिविकसित भएको पाइन्छ । नेपालको सामाजिक, राजनीतिक, आर्थिक, सांस्कृतिक तथा भाषिक क्षेत्रमा भएकाअनेक परिवर्तनका कारकलाई आधुनिक नेपाली कथाले प्रतिबिम्ब स्वीकार गरेको समयमा कथा सिर्जनाकोसीमारेखा निर्धारण भएको छ । यस प्रकारको सीमारेखा नै आधुनिक नेपाली कथाको मोड र प्रवृत्ति प्रकटहुने कारण बनेको छ । यसैले परिवर्तित मानकका छायापरिमण्डललाई अवलम्बन गरी नेपाली कथालेखिएको हुनाले आधुनिक नेपाली कथामा अनेक मोड र प्रवृत्ति स्थापना भएका छन् । नेपाली कथालेअवलम्बन गरेका मूल प्रवृत्तिलाई अध्ययन प्रयोजन स्वीकार गर्दा यसमा कालक्रमिक दृष्टिले मोड सिर्जनागर्ने राष्ट्रिय तथा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय परिस्थितिजन्य कारण के कस्ता थिए र के कस्ता मोड र प्रवृत्ति प्रकटभए ? कालक्रमिक विश्लेषण विधिको उपयोग गरी आधुनिक नेपाली कथामा मोड र प्रवृत्ति पहिचान गर्नेअभीष्ट यस लेखमा राखिएको छ ।)
american_english: (From the time when modern Nepali short-story writing got under way right up to the present, various modes and tendencies can be found to have developed. At the point when modern Nepali fiction took as its reflection the many factors of change occurring in Nepal's social, political, economic, cultural and linguistic spheres, the boundary line of story creation was set. This kind of boundary line has itself become the reason the modes and tendencies of the modern Nepali story come to light. Because Nepali fiction has been written by taking up the shadow sphere of changed norms, many modes and tendencies have become established in the modern Nepali story. When the principal tendencies adopted by Nepali fiction are accepted as the object of study, what were the national and international circumstantial causes that created modes in it over time, and what kinds of modes and tendencies came to the fore? By making use of the method of chronological analysis, this article sets out the aim of identifying the modes and tendencies in the modern Nepali story.)
british_english: (From the time when modern Nepali story writing began, down to the present day, various modes and tendencies can be found to have developed. At the moment when modern Nepali fiction accepted as its reflection the numerous factors of change in Nepal's social, political, economic, cultural and linguistic spheres, the boundary of story creation was determined. This very kind of boundary has become the reason why the modes and tendencies of the modern Nepali story are revealed. Since Nepali fiction has been written by adopting the shadow realm of altered standards, many modes and tendencies have been established in the modern Nepali story. When the principal tendencies adopted by Nepali fiction are accepted as the purpose of study, what were the national and international circumstantial causes that created modes in it over the course of time, and what sorts of modes and tendencies came to light? Using the method of chronological analysis, this article sets out the aim of identifying the modes and tendencies of the modern Nepali story.)
australian_english: (From when modern Nepali story writing first got going right through to the present, you can find a range of modes and tendencies that have developed. At the point when modern Nepali fiction took on board the many factors of change in Nepal's social, political, economic, cultural and language spheres as its reflection, the boundary line of story creation was set. That kind of boundary line is itself what has brought the modes and tendencies of the modern Nepali story to light. Since Nepali fiction has been written by adopting the shadow sphere of changed standards, a raft of modes and tendencies have become established in the modern Nepali story. Where the main tendencies the Nepali story has adopted are taken as the study's purpose, what were the national and international circumstances that created modes in it over time, and what kinds of modes and tendencies came to the fore? Using the chronological-analysis method, this article sets itself the aim of identifying the modes and tendencies in the modern Nepali story.)
informal_english: (From the days when modern Nepali story writing first kicked off right up to the present, you'll find all sorts of modes and tendencies have come on the go. At the point when modern Nepali fiction took on the many changes in Nepal's social, political, economic, cultural and language life as its mirror, the boundary line for making stories got drawn. It's that very kind of boundary line that's become the reason the modes and tendencies of the modern Nepali story show up. Since Nepali fiction has been written by taking on the shadow of changed standards, a whole slew of modes and tendencies have got themselves established in the modern Nepali story. When you take the main tendencies the Nepali story has taken on as the study's purpose, what were the national and international circumstances that gave rise to modes in it over the years, and what sorts of modes and tendencies came out? Using the chronological-analysis method, this article has set itself the aim of identifying the modes and tendencies in the modern Nepali story.)
translator_notes: Informal flavour rendered as Scottish English. The Nepali abstract is enclosed in parentheses and ends with a trailing ' ' entity; the parentheses are preserved in every variant and the entity is treated as no text. 'मोड' is rendered as 'mode' and 'प्रवृत्ति' as 'tendency' throughout. Sentence order follows the Nepali source exactly, including the interrogative sentence before the closing aim statement.
